engine.note: Recorded as provenance AND compared as a non-fatal drift notice (review finding F2). Never part of fingerprint_hash and never a halt: behavior is judged by behavior. See drift_notice_meaning.

drift_notice_meaning.proves: At least one engine source file differs, byte for byte, from the file the baseline was recorded against. Something in the engine was edited between the two recordings.
drift_notice_meaning.does_not_prove: That behavior changed. A comment, a rename, or a reordering all move a digest without moving a decision. It equally does not prove behavior did NOT change: the fingerprint samples one 300-tick trajectory, so an edit this trajectory never exercises is invisible to the behavioral gate and a digest change is the only signal that it happened at all.
drift_notice_meaning.severity: NOTICE, never a halt. The behavioral fingerprint remains the only halting gate. A drift notice with an identical fingerprint is the case worth a human glance: the engine changed and this trajectory did not notice.

environment.note: Recorded so that a future identical: true is a claim about two runs whose runtime identity is known, rather than an unexamined assumption that they shared one. Compared as a non-fatal DRIFT NOTICE, exactly like engine source digests; never a halt.

lineage.ratification_reference: NOT OPERATOR-RATIFIED -- decided in plan during the F1/F2/F5 repair; requires operator ratification before this baseline is treated as authoritative
lineage.reason: Review finding F1 repair: the prior baseline (b53dd903...) was recorded with hive-network REINFORCE learning ON at a hard-coded LEARNING_RATE=0.05, so it was never a frozen baseline and is invalid as one. Re-recorded with --freeze-hive-learning supplied, which is TRUE learning-OFF across every learning path in the engine (verified: tools/ticktock/test-hive-freeze.cjs, and an unfrozen control run at the same seed diverges from tick 0). This is the correction of an invalid baseline, not a re-baseline caused by an intentional engine improvement. The fingerprint additionally gains an environment block (F5) and the spec gains --freeze-hive-learning plus corrected limitations prose (F1/F2), both of which move colony_spec_hash.
